cond_0001.intro: This role involves developing, evaluating, and improving manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce cost, and improve product quality. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in engineering principles, a strong eye for detail, and the ability to work cross-functionally with other teams. Performs routine functions in a chemical laboratory, manufacturing, and office setting, assists technical personnel (Quality Control, Research and Development, and Production).
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Process Design and Implementation: Design and implement manufacturing processes, systems, and equipment by applying engineering principles and analysis. Develop process flow diagrams, layout plans, and capacity projections.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to enhance production efficiency, capacity, and quality.
Quality Assurance: Collaborate with the quality assurance team to define quality requirements for manufacturing processes. Develop and implement process control techniques and procedures.
Troubleshooting: Analyze manufacturing process flows for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and throughput. Diagnose and troubleshoot process issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Project Management: Lead and manage projects related to process development and improvement, equipment installation, and start-up. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Documentation: Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process improvement reports.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with R&D, production, maintenance, and other departments to facilitate process improvements and resolve process-related issues.
Training: Develop and provide training for production staff on new processes, technologies, and equipment to ensure smooth implementation and operation.
Safety and Environmental Assurance: Evaluates processes, equipment and procedures to ensure compliance with all environmental and safety rules and regulations.
Perform Other Duties as Assigned: Conducts basic testing in different chemical products, generates, posts, and sends Certificate of Analysis, assists R&D with routine basic quality and analytical testing, and supports activities in manufacturing (small batches), when required.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ability to solve practical problems.
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Ability to conduct rigorous data analysis, and the application of statistical methods to understand process variations and optimize performance.
Ability to perform complex math functions, compute ratios, rates and percentages.
Ability to effectively communicate with other team members.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access.
Physical Requirements: Frequently required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Expected to react to odors, typically present in a chemical laboratory. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering; however, will consider degrees in Industrial Engineering and Mechanical Engineering with 0 - 2 years professional experience.
The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to enhance production efficiency, capacity, and quality.
Quality Assurance: Collaborate with the quality assurance team to define quality requirements for manufacturing processes. Develop and implement process control techniques and procedures.
Troubleshooting: Analyze manufacturing process flows for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and throughput. Diagnose and troubleshoot process issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Project Management: Lead and manage projects related to process development and improvement, equipment installation, and start-up. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Documentation: Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process improvement reports.

cond_0038.intro: This role involves developing, evaluating, and improving manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce cost, and improve product quality. Performs routine functions in a chemical laboratory, manufacturing, and office setting, assists technical personnel (Quality Control, Research and Development, and Production).
cond_0038.responsibilities:
Process Design and Implementation: Design and implement manufacturing processes, systems, and equipment by applying engineering principles and analysis. Develop process flow diagrams, layout plans, and capacity projections.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to enhance production efficiency, capacity, and quality.
Quality Assurance: Collaborate with the quality assurance team to define quality requirements for manufacturing processes. Develop and implement process control techniques and procedures.
Troubleshooting: Analyze manufacturing process flows for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and throughput. Diagnose and troubleshoot process issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Project Management: Lead and manage projects related to process development and improvement, equipment installation, and start-up. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Documentation: Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process improvement reports.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with R&D, production, maintenance, and other departments to facilitate process improvements and resolve process-related issues.
Training: Develop and provide training for production staff on new processes, technologies, and equipment to ensure smooth implementation and operation.
Safety and Environmental Assurance: Evaluates processes, equipment and procedures to ensure compliance with all environmental and safety rules and regulations.
Perform Other Duties as Assigned: Conducts basic testing in different chemical products, generates, posts, and sends Certificate of Analysis, assists R&D with routine basic quality and analytical testing, and supports activities in manufacturing (small batches), when required.
cond_0038.requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred.

Up to 2 years of professional experience in Industrial Engineering or Mechanical Engineering considered in lieu of Chemical Engineering background.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to work effectively across teams.

cond_0159.intro: This role involves developing, evaluating, and improving manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce cost, and improve product quality. You'll regularly work cross-functionally with other teams and stay in close contact with technical personnel including Quality Control, Research and Development, and Production. A large part of the role is communicating and connecting with colleagues across departments to keep work moving forward.
cond_0159.responsibilities:
Process Design and Implementation: Design and implement manufacturing processes, systems, and equipment by applying engineering principles and analysis. Develop process flow diagrams, layout plans, and capacity projections — and actively communicate progress and trade-offs with relevant teams.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to enhance production efficiency, capacity, and quality. Bring people together to discuss and resolve improvement ideas as they arise.
Quality Assurance: Work closely and regularly with the quality assurance team to define quality requirements for manufacturing processes. Develop and implement process control techniques and procedures, and be ready to walk team members through decisions and explain requirements clearly.
Troubleshooting: Analyze manufacturing process flows for enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and throughput. Diagnose and troubleshoot process issues, initiate discussions to resolve them, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Project Management: Lead and manage projects related to process development and improvement, equipment installation, and start-up. Stay in ongoing contact with stakeholders to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Documentation: Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process improvement reports.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Connect daily with R&D, production, maintenance, and other departments to facilitate process improvements and resolve process-related issues. Speak up early when issues need cross-team alignment.
Training: Develop and deliver training for production staff on new processes, technologies, and equipment. Handle questions from staff and clarify requirements to ensure smooth implementation and operation.
Safety and Environmental Assurance: Evaluate processes, equipment, and procedures to ensure compliance with all environmental and safety rules and regulations.
Perform Other Duties as Assigned: Conduct basic testing in different chemical products, generate, post, and send Certificate of Analysis, assist R&D with routine basic quality and analytical testing, and support activities in manufacturing (small batches), when required.
cond_0159.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering preferred; however, will consider degrees in Industrial Engineering and Mechanical Engineering with 0 - 2 years professional experience preferred.
Ability to solve practical problems.
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Ability to conduct rigorous data analysis, and the application of statistical methods to understand process variations and optimize performance.
Ability to perform complex math functions, compute ratios, rates and percentages.
Ability to effectively communicate with other team members on a regular basis, including explaining trade-offs and clarifying requirements clearly.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access.
Frequently required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Expected to react to odors, typically present in a chemical laboratory. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

cond_0168.intro: This role involves developing, evaluating, and improving manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce cost, and improve product quality. You will regularly work cross-functionally with other teams and stay in close contact with technical personnel including Quality Control, Research and Development, and Production. The role spans a chemical laboratory, manufacturing, and office setting.
cond_0168.responsibilities:
Process Design and Implementation: Design and implement manufacturing processes, systems, and equipment by applying engineering principles and analysis. Develop process flow diagrams, layout plans, and capacity projections.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to enhance production efficiency, capacity, and quality.
Quality Assurance: Work closely with the quality assurance team on a regular basis to define quality requirements for manufacturing processes. Develop and implement process control techniques and procedures.
Troubleshooting: Analyze manufacturing process flows for enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and throughput. Diagnose and troubleshoot process issues and initiate corrective and preventive actions, bringing in the right people to resolve them quickly.
Project Management: Lead and manage projects related to process development and improvement, equipment installation, and start-up. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Documentation: Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process improvement reports.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Stay in regular contact with R&D, production, maintenance, and other departments to facilitate process improvements and resolve process-related issues. Actively contribute to discussions and speak up early when issues arise.
Training: Develop and deliver training for production staff on new processes, technologies, and equipment. Walk staff through new procedures and handle questions to ensure smooth implementation and operation.
Safety and Environmental Assurance: Evaluate processes, equipment, and procedures to ensure compliance with all environmental and safety rules and regulations.
Perform Other Duties as Assigned: Conduct basic testing on different chemical products, generate, post, and send Certificates of Analysis, assist R&D with routine basic quality and analytical testing, and support activities in manufacturing (small batches) when required.
cond_0168.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in Industrial Engineering or Mechanical Engineering with 0–2 years of professional experience.
Ability to solve practical problems.
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Ability to perform complex math functions, compute ratios, rates, and percentages.
Ability to communicate clearly and regularly with other team members.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering.
Ability to conduct rigorous data analysis and apply statistical methods to understand process variations and optimize performance.
Physical Requirements: Frequently required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Expected to react to odors typically present in a chemical laboratory. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.
Work Environment: Laboratory, office, and manufacturing environment.
The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

cond_0299.intro: This role involves developing, evaluating, and improving manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce cost, and improve product quality. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in engineering principles, a strong eye for detail, and the ability to work cross-functionally with other teams. Performs routine functions in a chemical laboratory, manufacturing, and office setting, assists technical personnel (Quality Control, Research and Development, and Production).
cond_0299.responsibilities:
Process Design and Implementation: Design and implement manufacturing processes, systems, and equipment by applying engineering principles and analysis. Develop process flow diagrams, layout plans, and capacity projections.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to enhance production efficiency, capacity, and quality.
Quality Assurance: Collaborate with the quality assurance team to define quality requirements for manufacturing processes. Develop and implement process control techniques and procedures.
Troubleshooting: Analyze manufacturing process flows for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and throughput. Diagnose and troubleshoot process issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Project Management: Lead and manage projects related to process development and improvement, equipment installation, and start-up. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Documentation: Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process improvement reports.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with R&D, production, maintenance, and other departments to facilitate process improvements and resolve process-related issues.
Training: Develop and provide training for production staff on new processes, technologies, and equipment to ensure smooth implementation and operation.
Safety and Environmental Assurance: Evaluates processes, equipment and procedures to ensure compliance with all environmental and safety rules and regulations.
Perform Other Duties as Assigned: Conducts basic testing in different chemical products, generates, posts, and sends Certificate of Analysis, assists R&D with routine basic quality and analytical testing, and supports activities in manufacturing (small batches), when required.
cond_0299.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Degrees in Industrial Engineering or Mechanical Engineering with demonstrated professional experience will also be considered.
Proven ability to solve practical problems with sound judgment.
Strong command of interpreting a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Demonstrated expertise in rigorous data analysis and the application of statistical methods to understand process variations and optimize performance.
Solid ability to perform complex math functions, compute ratios, rates, and percentages.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access.
Physical Requirements: Frequently required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Expected to react to odors, typically present in a chemical laboratory. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

cond_0367.intro: This role involves developing, evaluating, and improving manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce cost, and improve product quality. The role requires a solid background in engineering principles, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate with other teams as needed. Performs routine functions in a chemical laboratory, manufacturing, and office setting, and supports technical personnel in Quality Control, Research and Development, and Production.
cond_0367.responsibilities:
Process Design and Implementation: Design and implement manufacturing processes, systems, and equipment by applying engineering principles and analysis. Develop process flow diagrams, layout plans, and capacity projections.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to enhance production efficiency, capacity, and quality.
Quality Assurance: Coordinate with the quality assurance team to define quality requirements for manufacturing processes. Develop and implement process control techniques and procedures.
Troubleshooting: Analyze manufacturing process flows for enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and throughput. Diagnose and troubleshoot process issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Project Management: Plan and manage projects related to process development and improvement, equipment installation, and start-up. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Documentation: Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process improvement reports.
Cross-functional Coordination: Interface with R&D, production, maintenance, and other departments to support process improvements and resolve process-related issues.
Training: Develop and deliver training materials for production staff on new processes, technologies, and equipment to support smooth implementation and operation.
Safety and Environmental Assurance: Evaluate processes, equipment, and procedures to ensure compliance with all environmental and safety rules and regulations.
Perform Other Duties as Assigned: Conduct basic testing on chemical products, generate, post, and send Certificates of Analysis, assist R&D with routine basic quality and analytical testing, and support manufacturing activities (small batches) when required.
cond_0367.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.
Ability to solve practical problems.
Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Ability to perform complex math functions, compute ratios, rates, and percentages.
Clear written communication and direct verbal reporting when coordinating with team members.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access.
Preferred Requirements
0–2 Years of professional experience.
Ability to conduct rigorous data analysis and apply statistical methods to understand process variations and optimize performance.
Physical Requirements: Frequently required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Expected to react to odors typically present in a chemical laboratory. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.
Work Environment: Laboratory, office, and manufacturing environment.

cond_0376.intro: This role involves developing, evaluating, and improving manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce cost, and improve product quality. The role requires a solid background in engineering principles, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate with other teams as needed. Responsibilities include routine functions in a chemical laboratory, manufacturing, and office setting, and supporting technical personnel in Quality Control, Research and Development, and Production.
cond_0376.responsibilities:
Process Design and Implementation: Design and implement manufacturing processes, systems, and equipment by applying engineering principles and analysis. Develop process flow diagrams, layout plans, and capacity projections.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to enhance production efficiency, capacity, and quality.
Quality Assurance: Coordinate with the quality assurance team to define quality requirements for manufacturing processes. Develop and implement process control techniques and procedures.
Troubleshooting: Analyze manufacturing process flows for enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and throughput. Diagnose and troubleshoot process issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Project Management: Manage projects related to process development and improvement, equipment installation, and start-up. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Documentation: Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process improvement reports.
Cross-functional Coordination: Interface with R&D, production, maintenance, and other departments to support process improvements and resolve process-related issues.
Training: Develop and deliver training materials for production staff on new processes, technologies, and equipment to support smooth implementation and operation.
Safety and Environmental Assurance: Evaluate processes, equipment, and procedures to ensure compliance with all environmental and safety rules and regulations.
Perform Other Duties as Assigned: Conduct basic testing on chemical products, generate, post, and send Certificates of Analysis, assist R&D with routine basic quality and analytical testing, and support manufacturing activities (small batches) when required.
cond_0376.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering preferred; however, will consider degrees in Industrial Engineering and Mechanical Engineering with 0 - 2 years professional experience preferred.
Ability to solve practical problems.
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Ability to conduct rigorous data analysis, and the application of statistical methods to understand process variations and optimize performance.
Ability to perform complex math functions, compute ratios, rates and percentages.
Ability to communicate clearly with other team members in written and verbal form.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access.
Physical Requirements: Frequently required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Expected to react to odors, typically present in a chemical laboratory. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.
Work Environment: Laboratory, office, and manufacturing environment.
The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

cond_0404.intro: This role involves developing, evaluating, and improving manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce cost, and improve product quality. You will own cross-functional work with other teams and take responsibility for outcomes across a chemical laboratory, manufacturing, and office setting, including direct support to Quality Control, Research and Development, and Production.
cond_0404.responsibilities:
Process Design and Implementation: Design and implement manufacturing processes, systems, and equipment by applying engineering principles and analysis. Develop process flow diagrams, layout plans, and capacity projections.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and drive continuous improvement opportunities to enhance production efficiency, capacity, and quality.
Quality Assurance: Lead collaboration with the quality assurance team to define quality requirements for manufacturing processes. Develop and implement process control techniques and procedures.
Troubleshooting: Analyze manufacturing process flows for enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and throughput. Diagnose and resolve process issues and execute corrective and preventive actions.
Project Management: Direct and manage projects related to process development and improvement, equipment installation, and start-up. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Documentation: Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process improvement reports.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Drive coordination with R&D, production, maintenance, and other departments to deliver process improvements and resolve process-related issues.
Training: Develop and deliver training for production staff on new processes, technologies, and equipment to ensure smooth implementation and operation.
Safety and Environmental Assurance: Evaluate processes, equipment, and procedures to ensure compliance with all environmental and safety rules and regulations.
Perform Other Duties as Assigned: Conduct basic testing in different chemical products, generate, post, and send Certificate of Analysis, support R&D with routine basic quality and analytical testing, and execute activities in manufacturing (small batches), when required.
cond_0404.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.
Ability to solve practical problems.
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Ability to effectively communicate with other team members.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access.
Preferred Requirements
0–2 Years of professional experience.
Ability to conduct rigorous data analysis and apply statistical methods to understand process variations and optimize performance.
Ability to perform complex math functions, compute ratios, rates, and percentages.
Physical Requirements: Frequently required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Expected to react to odors, typically present in a chemical laboratory. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.
Work Environment: Laboratory, office, and manufacturing environment.

Performs routine functions in a chemical laboratory, manufacturing, and office setting, assists technical personnel (Quality Control, Research and Development, and Production).
cond_0425.responsibilities:
Process Design and Implementation: Design and implement manufacturing processes, systems, and equipment by applying engineering principles and analysis. Develop process flow diagrams, layout plans, and capacity projections.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to enhance production efficiency, capacity, and quality.
Quality Assurance: Collaborate with the quality assurance team to define quality requirements for manufacturing processes. Develop and implement process control techniques and procedures.
Troubleshooting: Analyze manufacturing process flows for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and throughput. Diagnose and troubleshoot process issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Project Management: Lead and manage projects related to process development and improvement, equipment installation, and start-up. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Documentation: Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process improvement reports.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with R&D, production, maintenance, and other departments to facilitate process improvements and resolve process-related issues.
Training: Develop and provide training for production staff on new processes, technologies, and equipment to ensure smooth implementation and operation.
Safety and Environmental Assurance: Evaluates processes, equipment and procedures to ensure compliance with all environmental and safety rules and regulations.
Perform Other Duties as Assigned: Conducts basic testing in different chemical products, generates, posts, and sends Certificate of Analysis, assists R&D with routine basic quality and analytical testing, and supports activities in manufacturing (small batches), when required.
cond_0425.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Degrees in Industrial Engineering or Mechanical Engineering with demonstrated professional experience will also be considered.
Proven ability to solve practical problems with sound judgment.
Strong command of interpreting a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Demonstrated expertise in rigorous data analysis and the application of statistical methods to understand process variations and optimize performance.
Solid ability to perform complex math functions, compute ratios, rates, and percentages.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access.
Physical Requirements: Frequently required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Expected to react to odors, typically present in a chemical laboratory. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.
cond_0425.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.

Performs routine functions in a chemical laboratory, manufacturing, and office setting, assists technical personnel (Quality Control, Research and Development, and Production). People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with manufacturing processes and chemical environments.
cond_0464.responsibilities:
Process Design and Implementation: Design and implement manufacturing processes, systems, and equipment by applying engineering principles and analysis. Develop process flow diagrams, layout plans, and capacity projections.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to enhance production efficiency, capacity, and quality.
Quality Assurance: Collaborate with the quality assurance team to define quality requirements for manufacturing processes. Develop and implement process control techniques and procedures.
Troubleshooting: Analyze manufacturing process flows for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and throughput. Diagnose and troubleshoot process issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Project Management: Lead and manage projects related to process development and improvement, equipment installation, and start-up. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Documentation: Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process improvement reports.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with R&D, production, maintenance, and other departments to facilitate process improvements and resolve process-related issues.
Training: Develop and provide training for production staff on new processes, technologies, and equipment to ensure smooth implementation and operation.
Safety and Environmental Assurance: Evaluates processes, equipment and procedures to ensure compliance with all environmental and safety rules and regulations.
Perform Other Duties as Assigned: Conducts basic testing in different chemical products, generates, posts, and sends Certificate of Analysis, assists R&D with routine basic quality and analytical testing, and supports activities in manufacturing (small batches), when required.
cond_0464.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering preferred; however, will consider degrees in Industrial Engineering and Mechanical Engineering with 0 - 2 years professional experience preferred.
Ability to solve practical problems.
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Ability to conduct rigorous data analysis, and the application of statistical methods to understand process variations and optimize performance.
Ability to perform complex math functions, compute ratios, rates and percentages.
Ability to effectively communicate with other team members.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access.
Frequently required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Expected to react to odors, typically present in a chemical laboratory. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

Performs routine functions in a chemical laboratory, manufacturing, and office setting, assists technical personnel (Quality Control, Research and Development, and Production). People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with process engineering and chemical manufacturing work.
cond_0581.responsibilities:
Process Design and Implementation: Design and implement manufacturing processes, systems, and equipment by applying engineering principles and analysis. Develop process flow diagrams, layout plans, and capacity projections.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to enhance production efficiency, capacity, and quality.
Quality Assurance: Collaborate with the quality assurance team to define quality requirements for manufacturing processes. Develop and implement process control techniques and procedures.
Troubleshooting: Analyze manufacturing process flows for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and throughput. Diagnose and troubleshoot process issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Project Management: Lead and manage projects related to process development and improvement, equipment installation, and start-up. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Documentation: Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process improvement reports.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with R&D, production, maintenance, and other departments to facilitate process improvements and resolve process-related issues.
Training: Develop and provide training for production staff on new processes, technologies, and equipment to ensure smooth implementation and operation.
Safety and Environmental Assurance: Evaluates processes, equipment and procedures to ensure compliance with all environmental and safety rules and regulations.
Perform Other Duties as Assigned: Conducts basic testing in different chemical products, generates, posts, and sends Certificate of Analysis, assists R&D with routine basic quality and analytical testing, and supports activities in manufacturing (small batches), when required.
cond_0581.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ability to solve practical problems.
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Ability to conduct rigorous data analysis, and the application of statistical methods to understand process variations and optimize performance.
Ability to perform complex math functions, compute ratios, rates and percentages.
Ability to effectively communicate with other team members.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering; however, will consider degrees in Industrial Engineering and Mechanical Engineering with 0 - 2 years professional experience.
Physical Requirements: Frequently required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Expected to react to odors, typically present in a chemical laboratory. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.
Work Environment: Laboratory, office, and manufacturing environment.
The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.
